subject: POC evaluation gate, trial plan, and exec decision window
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@healixsystems.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healixsystems.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC evaluation gate, trial plan, and exec decision window

Hi Susan / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: Assistants for support triage and knowledge retrieval (customer success workflows).
- Key buyer goals: reduce time-to-first-response, improve suggested article relevance, and keep inference cost predictable for production.

Proposed trial scope (6 weeks) — please confirm:
1) Duration: 6 calendar weeks (pilot cluster provisioned week of Dec 7).
2) Data & traffic: 5k seed prompts + live shadow traffic at 10rps peak.
3) Success criteria (we suggested; please confirm/edit):
   - Quality: average relevance score >= 0.85 on seeded eval set (manual review + rubric).
   - Latency: p95 <= 200ms for gen endpoint under pilot load.
   - Cost: per-1k-token unit cost improvement >= 25% vs current infra (estimated).
4) Ownership: Healix product to provide seed prompt set and evaluation rubric; Redwood will run metrics dashboard and provide daily ingest of logs.

Decision / exec readout:
- We propose a 30–45 minute exec readout + go/no-go slot in the week of Dec 14 (typical format: short results deck, live demo of top failure modes, recommendation).
- Suggested attendees from Healix: CTO (Tom), VP Product (Lisa), and Procurement. Redwood will invite a single exec from our side (Marcus) + solutions lead (Priyom).

Attachments: I attached a one-page mutual action plan and the draft success metrics spreadsheet ("mutual-action-plan.pdf", "healix-poc-success-metrics.xlsx"). Also linking the shared doc where we can iterate: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C-HEALIX-POC

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above and availability for an exec readout window (Dec 14–18)? Also please confirm the procurement contact for next-step contracting.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@healixsystems.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC evaluation gate, trial plan, and exec decision window

Ava / team —

Following up with the operational side notes so we can include them in the mutual action plan:

Operational plan (high level)
- Trial infra: we'll provision a dedicated trial cluster (2x A10G equiv) with isolated KV cache.
- Traffic shaping: implement a 10rps throttling policy and a 50% burst cap for the first 48 hours to stabilize the KV cache.
- Data handling: logs will be shipped to a Healix-owned S3 bucket; Redwood will only ingest hashes for evaluation unless you opt in to raw logs.

Measurement & evaluation owner matrix
- Healix: seed prompt set, rubric, and manual review panel.
- Redwood: automated relevance scoring pipeline, latency/cost dashboards, daily sync.
- Priyom: will own the experiment config and on-call for infra tweaks during the trial.

Risks / mitigations
- If relevance falls below 0.8 at any readout, we trigger an immediate model fallback to the baseline model and block traffic until root cause analysis (RCA) completes.
- Procurement gating: legal redlines may delay contract signing; recommend procurement contact be included asap.

I'll draft the operational section for the mutual action plan and attach the final experiment JSON before we send to Healix.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Thanks Ava — this reads well and aligns with internal expectations. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria tweaks:
   - We want the relevance threshold expressed as: ">= 85% top-1 relevance on seeded prompts when averaged across reviewers".
   - Latency: p95 <= 250ms (Tom is nervous about optimistic 200ms number; 250ms is more realistic given our integrations).

2) Timeline: We prefer a slightly shifted window — can we provision starting Dec 9 and target the exec readout for Dec 16 at 10:00 AM PT? That gives our reviewers two full weeks of evaluation.

3) Attendees & decision authority:
   - Decision maker: Tom Alvarez (CTO) for technical go/no-go; Lisa Chen (VP Product) will recommend readiness.
   - Procurement contact above (procurement@healixsystems.com) will handle contract steps and redlines.

4) Compliance ask: Please attach your SOC 2 summary and a short note on data retention—Tom wants to share with security.

We confirm the seed prompt set and rubric; I'll upload the file to the shared doc by end of day Monday.

— Susan Park
Director, Product Operations | Healix Systems

Subject: Final prep: evaluation sheet + readout checklist

Susan / team —

Quick check-in ahead of the exec readout on the 16th. I've attached the finalized evaluation workbook (healix-poc-success-metrics.xlsx) and included a one-page readout checklist below. Please review the final decision gate wording so we can lock the slide that Tom will see.

Readout checklist (for Redwood + Healix):
- One-slide baseline vs pilot comparison (latency, cost, relevance).
- Top 5 failure cases with remediation plan.
- Live noise-case demo (Priyom owns failover).
- Recommendation: proceed to contract with Reserved plan OR require additional 2-week remediation window.

Decision gate verbiage (proposal):
"Go" if pilot meets: relevance >=85% AND (latency p95 <=250ms OR demonstrable mitigation plan signed off by Tom).

If you want wording adjusted, reply-all and I'll update the slide. Otherwise I'll send the final deck and calendar invite to Tom/Lisa/procurement.

— Marcus
